cases.title: Inventory and escape
cases.outcome: Missed the descent mission; inspected inventory and escaped through the D:1 upstairs.
sourcePointers: do.c doup: ledger-1 escape confirmation (C lines 1330–1335). At 64224b4b, JS doup refuses before boundary 12 on <; C asks whether to leave the dungeon.
cases.mission: Explore D:1, use inventory, find stairs and attempt a return journey
cases.reproducibility: Independent C replay matched the complete parsed recording.

cases.title: Descend and return
cases.outcome: Explored D:1, descended to D:2 and returned; inventory and combat, ending at 6/16 HP.
cases.mission: Explore several D:1 rooms, descend to D:2, and attempt a return to D:1 without ascending out of the dungeon
cases.reproducibility: Independent C replay matched the complete parsed recording.

cases.title: Transfer and nested containers
cases.outcome: Debug wishes set up containers; ordinary loot and tip commands moved mixed contents and a nested sack between floor and carried containers.
sourcePointers: pickup.c dotip: inventory selection via getobj and tip_ok (C line 3624; JS inventory path refuses at boundary 153).
pickup.c tipcontainer: container-to-container transfer loop (C lines 3688–3841; next unported branch in js/pickup.js).
cases.mission: Use debug wishes only for setup; then exercise ordinary floor and carried container insertion/removal, mixed contents, and direct #tip into a carried bag of holding with safe nested containers.
cases.reproducibility: Independent C replay matched the complete parsed recording.

cases.title: Jump, revisit, and return
cases.outcome: Ordinary Knight attempts jumping around a pet, then jumps from a changed position, inspects inventory and returns to the upstairs tile.
sourcePointers: apply.c dojump, jump, check_jump and is_valid_jump_pos: physical jumping, destination constraints, obstacles and repeated position changes.
cases.mission: Ordinary Knight attempts a legal knight-move jump, walks back, inspects inventory, attempts another jump under a changed position, and explores toward stairs if reachable
cases.reproducibility: Independent C replay matched every parsed segment exactly.

cases.title: Cookie, fire, and re-quiver
cases.outcome: Debug setup supplies a boomerang; ordinary actions read a fortune cookie, cancel and complete quivering, fire and retrieve the projectile, and re-quiver it.
sourcePointers: eat.c fpostfx FORTUNE_COOKIE and rumors.c outrumor: eating and reading the cookie.
wield.c doquiver_core: cancelled and successful inventory selection, clearing and refilling the quiver.
dothrow.c dofire and throwit: firing and retrieving a boomerang.
cases.mission: Debug setup, then ordinarily eat a fortune cookie, inspect inventory, quiver a projectile, throw/fire it, retrieve it, and re-quiver with a cancelled selection before success.
cases.reproducibility: Independent C replay matched every parsed segment exactly.
